levels.label: 2. OG — conditional area study
levels.source: Resident-confirmed twenty-room arrangement, windows, W4/L1 overlap and 1/4 L3 : 3/4 R1 staircase; resident-requested thickness hypotheses for four outside end walls, 15 November 2026. Conditional area and wall allowances are explicitly estimated.
levels.notes: The source shell and confirmed relative arrangement remain. Seventeen rooms approach a conditional 16.4m² internal-envelope benchmark through deeper envelopes and small estimated divider changes; unknown internal service partitions are not deducted. R1–R3 stop at a declared connector study guard and retain an explicit area shortfall. This is a falsifiable area study, not an as-built floor plan or verified usable-area calculation.
